edges.mechanism: In SELECT, vitamin E 400 IU/d alone raised prostate cancer risk (HR 1.17); selenium 200 ug/d plus vitamin E gave no benefit (HR 1.05). Vitamin E harm concentrated in men with low selenium status; neither agent prevented dementia.
edges.evidence: Large RCT (n=35,533) plus case-cohort and PREADViSE analyses; high certainty of no benefit

edges.mechanism: Selenium drives deiodinase-mediated T4 metabolism; in combined severe iodine and selenium deficiency, selenium alone may worsen hypothyroidism, so iodine should be corrected first. No synergy on thyroid function in mild deficiency.
edges.evidence: Field studies, expert review and RCT in older New Zealanders; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Zn/Se co-supplementation raised RMR and selenium levels but not thyroid function or zinc levels; both minerals take part in thyroid hormone metabolism.
edges.evidence: Single small RCT plus review; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Combined Se-yeast 200 ug/d and CoQ10 200 mg/d for 4 years reduced cardiovascular mortality in low-selenium elderly Swedes (HR 0.51) and raised SELENOP; effect persisted for 10-12 years.
edges.evidence: Single RCT (n=443) with long follow-up; hypothesis-generating; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Myo-inositol plus selenium lowered TSH more than selenium alone in Hashimoto thyroiditis with subclinical hypothyroidism; no added effect on TPOAb.
edges.evidence: MA of 3 studies (n=288) and network MA; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Very selenium-rich food; 2 nuts/day match 100 ug SeMet. Regular Brazil-nut eaters plus supplement users may exceed the UL (EFSA 255 ug/d; US 400 ug/d).
edges.evidence: RCT and EFSA risk assessment

edges.mechanism: Antioxidant selenium may reduce cisplatin nephrotoxicity, myelosuppression and (preclinically) GPX4-mediated ototoxicity; whether antitumor efficacy is preserved in humans is unproven.
edges.evidence: Small RCTs with mixed results, Cochrane insufficient evidence, preclinical data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: In selenium-deficient patients, selenite reduced radiation-induced diarrhea; no overall survival or recurrence benefit; selenium-replete patients did not benefit.
edges.evidence: Phase 3 RCT (n=81) and systematic review; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Statins may impair Sec-tRNA isopentenylation and thus selenoprotein synthesis (hypothesis); selenium + CoQ10 did not improve statin myopathy beyond CoQ10.
edges.evidence: Hypothesis paper and 2 small RCTs; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: An antioxidant cocktail containing selenium (with vitamins E, C and beta-carotene) blunted the HDL2 rise and attenuated angiographic and clinical benefit of simvastatin-niacin (HATS).
edges.evidence: RCT (n=160) and lipoprotein substudy; selenium-specific contribution unknown; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Selenium lowers TPOAb in levothyroxine-treated and TSH in untreated Hashimoto patients; thyroid tests may shift.
edges.evidence: MAs of RCTs; moderate certainty for antibody lowering

edges.mechanism: Adding selenium 200 ug/d to antithyroid drugs did not change Graves remission or quality of life.
edges.evidence: Multicentre RCT GRASS (n=430); moderate certainty

edges.mechanism: Selenium supplementation in replete populations increases T2D risk (RCT RR 1.11; NPC HR 1.55); Mendelian randomization concordant.
edges.evidence: MAs of RCTs/observational data, RCT secondary analyses, MR; moderate certainty

edges.mechanism: U-shaped risk: in men with high baseline toenail selenium, supplementation raised high-grade prostate cancer by 91%; 300 ug/d for 5 years raised all-cause mortality (HR 1.59).
edges.evidence: SELECT case-cohort, Denmark PRECISE RCT and reviews; low-moderate certainty

edges.mechanism: Selenium yeast 200 ug/d increased SCC (HR 1.25) and total NMSC in patients with prior skin cancer.
edges.evidence: RCT (NPC, n=1312) and dose-response MA; moderate certainty

edges.mechanism: Selenium lowers TPOAb (SMD -0.96) and modestly TSH; clinical benefit uncertain.
edges.evidence: MAs of RCTs; Cochrane review of clinical outcomes inconclusive

edges.mechanism: Selenium 100 ug twice daily improved QoL and slowed progression in mild GO; MAs show CAS reduction with inconsistent QoL effects; EUGOGO lists selenium for mild active GO in selenium-deficient areas.
edges.evidence: RCT (n=159), 2 MAs, guideline; low certainty

edges.mechanism: True physiological reduction (not an assay artifact) of TPOAb/TgAb during supplementation may change interpretation of serial antibody results.
edges.evidence: MAs of RCTs

edges.mechanism: Genotype modified selenium status, GPx activity and DNA-damage response to Brazil-nut selenium.
edges.evidence: Small human intervention studies; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Variants alter plasma SELENOP isoform ratios and glucose/cholesterol responses to Brazil nuts.
edges.evidence: Small human studies; very low certainty
